successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: Dardania 'was centered around present-day Kosovo, but also included parts of North Macedonia' (and parts of Serbia and Albania, no extent on the page); the Kumanovo and Skopje municipalities are a…

ledger.x: 230: the Dardani under Longarus capture Bylazora.

wars.name: Dardanian war against Macedon (Longarus)
wars.outcome: The Dardani took Bylazora from the Paeonians in 230 and defeated Demetrius II (230-229); Philip V recaptured Bylazora in 217.

wars.name: Bellum Dardanicum
wars.outcome: 'in 75-73 BCE the Dardani had to face terrible conflicts against Rome, known as Bellum Dardanicum'; the page does not give the result.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier of Dardania; the extent is 'centered around present-day Kosovo'.
